name: Blazing Scorcher
description: A fiery warrior who strikes fast and burns bright.
flavorText: The flame needs no invitation.

name: Fury Rune
description: A rune channeling the raw power of Fury.
flavorText: Rage given form.

name: Get Excited!
description: Deal 3 damage to anything.
flavorText: BOOM! Hahaha!

name: Captain Farron
description: When I'm summoned, create 3 Decimates in hand.
flavorText: The battlefield bends to his command.

name: Darius, Trifarian
description: The Hand of Noxus demands absolute strength.
flavorText: They will kneel, or they will fall.

name: Charm
description: Recall a unit.
flavorText: A glance that steals the heart and stills the blade.

name: Solari Shieldbearer
description: Daybreak: Grant me +0|+2.
flavorText: The sun's light is her armor and her oath.

name: Ahri, Alluring
description: When allies are recalled, I gain +1|+0.
flavorText: Every soul holds a story worth hearing.

name: Lee Sin, Ascetic
description: When you cast a spell, grant me Challenger this round.
flavorText: The dragon's will flows through disciplined hands.

name: Eager Apprentice
description: When I'm summoned, refill 2 spell mana.
flavorText: She studies the arcane with reckless enthusiasm.

name: Mind Rune
description: A rune channeling the infinite depths of Mind.
flavorText: Knowledge is the truest weapon.

name: Heimerdinger, Inventor
description: When you play a spell, create a turret of equal cost.
flavorText: Innovation requires a keen mind and an even keener turret.

name: Viktor, Innovator
description: When you play a created card, grant me a random keyword.
flavorText: Evolution is not a choice. It is an inevitability.

name: Teemo, Strategist
description: Strike: Plant 5 Poison Mushrooms in the enemy deck.
flavorText: Size means nothing when you know every hiding spot.

name: Arena Bar
description: When an ally survives damage, grant it +1|+0.
flavorText: Every scar tells the story of a fight survived.

name: Crackshot Corsair
description: When we attack, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
flavorText: A perfect shot from the crow's nest never misses.

name: Pirate's Haven
description: When you Plunder, draw 1.
flavorText: The safest port is the one no map can find.

name: Qiyana, Victorious
description: When I'm summoned, create a Rune of the current element.
flavorText: The elements are mine to command.

name: Sett, Brawler
description: When I take damage, store it. Attack: deal stored damage.
flavorText: The Boss doesn't go down easy.

name: Morbid Return
description: Revive the strongest dead ally.
flavorText: Death is but a doorway for those who know the way back.

name: Sneaky Deckhand
description: I can only be blocked by Elusive units.
flavorText: By the time you see her, your gold is already gone.

name: Twisted Fate, Gambler
description: Play: pick a card — Blue, Red, or Gold.
flavorText: It's not about the hand you're dealt. It's how you play it.

name: Jinx, Rebel
description: When you empty your hand, draw 1 and create a Super Mega Death Rocket!
flavorText: Rules are made to be broken. Like buildings. Or people.

name: Vanguard Sergeant
description: When I'm summoned, create a For Demacia! in hand.
flavorText: Rally to me! For the king and the realm!

name: Shen, Kinkou
description: Support: Give my supported ally Barrier.
flavorText: Balance in all things.

name: Ashe, Warmother
description: Attack: Frostbite the strongest enemy.
flavorText: The cold does not forgive, and neither does the Warmother.

name: Avarosan Hearthguard
description: When I'm summoned, give all allies in your deck +1|+1.
flavorText: The hearthguard carries the warmth of home into every battle.

name: Flash Freeze
description: Frostbite an enemy.
flavorText: A single breath of the Freljord can halt any advance.

name: Spectral Rider
description: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 if an ally died this round.
flavorText: The rider emerges from the mist, seeking souls owed to the Isles.

name: Spirit Fire
description: Give all enemies -2|-0 this round, then deal 1 to all enemies.
flavorText: The spirits hunger, and the fire answers.

name: Irelia, Blade Dancer
description: When allies attack, swap me with the attacker.
flavorText: The blades dance for Ionia.

name: Rivershaper
description: When I Strike, draw 1.
flavorText: She reads the river like a scroll, and its currents obey.

name: Howling Abyss
description: Round Start: Create a random champion in hand. It costs 0.
flavorText: At the edge of the world, even gods fall silent.

name: Omen Hawk
description: When I'm summoned, grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
flavorText: It circles once, then dives. The hunt begins.

name: Swain, Grand General
description: When you deal non-combat damage, drain the enemy Nexus for 1.
flavorText: Vision without power is nothing.

name: Senna, Redeemer
description: When I'm summoned, grant all allies +1|+0. Level Up: I've seen you damage the enemy Nexus 5+ times.
flavorText: Light and shadow are not opposites. They are partners.

name: Rift Herald
description: When I'm summoned, deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
flavorText: It tears through the veil between worlds, hungry and reckless.

name: Nature's Wrath
description: Heal an ally to full and grant it +2|+0 this round.
flavorText: The jungle provides for those who listen.
